item.title: AI Bot development issues
item.description:
250-750 AUD | I'm developing an AI bot for private use and need to refine its design and user experience.
Key improvements needed: - Streamlining the bot's functionality for efficiency - Enhancing overall design for better usability **Title: cTrader C# Developer Needed to Audit and Align an Adaptive Demo and Live Trading Bot**
I’m looking for an experienced cTrader Automate/C# developer to investigate and fix differences between my cloud demo bot and local live-account bot.
The project is **Jye Gold V8 Adaptive**, currently used for **XAUUSD on five-minute candles with Pepperstone**. I have the existing source code, compiled builds, parameter exports, journals, test results and saved local learning checkpoints.
**The main problem**
The demo and live versions were intended to use the same adaptive strategy, with the additional account permissions needed for live trading. In practice, their behaviour and results have differed.
The live bot has sometimes opened and closed trades within seconds, including taking very small profits or losses. Logs show that some of these exits came from the model deciding its expected edge had faded or reversed, rather than the trailing stop being hit. I need the developer to establish whether those decisions are correct, whether the forecasts are being applied consistently, and why the demo behaves differently.
**What has already been identified**
- The demo and live instances have separate learned model states. Copying the strategy code and parameters did not transfer the demo’s accumulated learning. - An earlier exit-buffer change was applied only to the live version. That change was subsequently removed, and the latest live candidate’s decision engine was matched to the demo engine and checked with replay tests. - Other repairs have addressed quote changes during saving that cancelled entry attempts, a delayed trade-closure/checkpoint issue, and position ownership problems caused by shared labels between bot copies. - Local learning restoration has been implemented and observed working through restarts of the same instance. - The cloud demo’s model is currently held in memory for that run. A verified export and durable recovery mechanism for its exact learned state remains unresolved.
These are the recorded findings so far. I want the current installed versions and native logs audited, rather than assuming every earlier issue is still present or that all repairs are fully proven.
**What I need done**
1. Compare the actual demo and live builds, parameters, model states and execution paths. 2. Reproduce the rapid exits and explain the precise entry and exit decisions, including conflicting short- and longer-horizon forecasts. 3. Check candle timing, tick updates, bid/ask prices, spread, commissions, slippage and execution delays. 4. Establish a reliable model-only export/import process where supported. Keep account-specific positions, orders and ownership records separate. 5. Verify restart recovery, duplicate-order prevention and isolation between multiple instances. 6. Preserve the intended stop-loss, trailing-stop and sizing behaviour. Any strategy changes should be clearly explained and tested against the baseline. 7. Reconcile results using this bot’s confirmed trades and net results after costs, separately from manual trades and unrelated account history.
**Deliverables**
I want a clear root-cause report, corrected source and compiled package, a documented list of changes, and reproducible test evidence. Given identical model state and market inputs, the strategy decisions should match; genuine broker/execution differences should be explained.
Initial testing should use simulation or demo. Live activation will remain under my control.
Please include your relevant cTrader/C# experience, how you would investigate this, and separate estimates for the initial audit and subsequent fixes. I’m looking for reliable, measurable engineering work—not a promise of guaranteed profits.
Source code and redacted supporting records can be provided privately.
Ideal Skills and Experience: - Expertise in AI bot design - Strong background in UX/UI design - Experience in optimizing bot interactions
Looking for a freelancer who can ensure my AI bot is user-friendly and visually appealing. It’s currently demo trial has had great results but the live trial seems to be not working the same the project has been developed with chat gpt and vis code on ctrader platform

item.title: Build Modern Pushpay-Integrated Church Platform
item.description:
200-300 USD | Project Title: Developer Needed for Modern Mega-Church Web Platform (Pushpay Integration & Zero-Cost Architecture)
Project Overview: Our goal is to build a contemporary, engaging platform that communicates our vision, welcomes first-time visitors, showcases our ministries, and gives easy access to sermons and church activities, with the overarching purpose of pointing everyone who visits to Jesus.
We are looking for an experienced developer who can build a high-performance, mobile-first web platform while adhering strictly to our architectural, security, and integration requirements.
Key Requirements & Scope of Work 1. Pushpay as Our Central Repository Pushpay ChMS must remain the authoritative source for all church-management information to avoid creating separate databases or duplicating information locally on the website. Specifically:
Calendar & Groups: Church calendar and public group listings must pull directly from Pushpay via API or approved embeds.
Forms & Registrations: Connection cards, event registrations, and other forms must utilize secure Pushpay forms so information stays in the central repository.
Children’s Pre-Registration: Must use a secure, approved Pushpay form process so children’s sensitive information is never stored locally on the platform.
Prayer Requests: Must utilize a confidential submission process with clear permission rules.
Online Giving: Must link seamlessly to our existing Pushpay giving platform rather than a custom payment portal.
Note on API: Please specify your technical approach for connecting the platform to Pushpay, which APIs or embeds you intend to use, and how data caching/refresh rates will be managed.
2. Design and User Experience The platform must feature:
A video-enhanced homepage hero section.
A dedicated "Plan a Visit" feature for first-time guests.
A church history timeline and member testimonials ("Why I choose and love this church").
A dedicated livestream page and a searchable, filterable sermon library.
Modern, visually appealing, mobile-friendly design with lightning-fast load times.
Clear organization for essential information: mission, vision, beliefs, leadership, ministries, service times, and physical location.
3. Content Management and Ownership
The backend must be structured so our administrative staff can easily update text, photographs, ministry information, and announcements on their own without needing developer assistance for routine changes.
4. Chatbot and Ongoing Costs
We are open to introducing a chatbot to act as a digital usher, but it must be a 100% free-tier or open-source implementation with zero recurring monthly subscription costs for hosting, usage, or maintenance. Please outline your approach for keeping all third-party tool costs at $0.
5. Security and Maintenance Please detail your proposed approach to:
Data security and protection of personal information.
Secure storage and protection of Pushpay API credentials (e.g., using environment variables).
Role-based access permissions for staff and volunteers.
Automated backups and ongoing maintenance/updates.
Disaster recovery if the platform or a connected service goes down.
6. Additional Considerations
Emergency Alert Banner: Staff must have an intuitive toggle in the backend to quickly post a site-wide notice when services are canceled or changed because of severe weather or other emergencies.
To Apply, Please Provide: Links to 2-3 recent modern web platforms you have built from scratch (church or non-profit projects are preferred).
Your technical approach to integrating Pushpay forms/embeds and handling data securely without local storage.
Your proposed milestone structure, timeline, and cost estimate.

item.title: Build a marketplace website..
item.description: 250-750 USD | Free Moving Marketplace — Website Development Project Project Overview We are seeking an experienced Bubble developer to build Free Moving Marketplace, a customer-facing moving-services marketplace initially serving the San Francisco Bay Area. We are a marketplace, not a moving company. Customers will submit moving information, receive manually prepared guaranteed price quotes, and either book at that price or participate in a moving-date auction. The website should be professional, mobile-friendly, easy to navigate, and built primarily using Bubble's existing functionality. We want a straightforward, cost-effective implementation with minimal custom development. Most administrative operations will be handled manually. Customer Accounts and Moving Inventory Customers can register, log in, and access their own moving information. Customers enter their moving date, pickup address, and delivery address. Customers can upload multiple furniture photos, upload written inventory lists, or manually select furniture and quantities from our predefined furniture catalog. We will provide the master furniture catalog, including item descriptions and cubic-foot values. The catalog must remain editable within Bubble. All customer submissions must be stored in Bubble's database and accessible to us through its built-in administrative tools. We will manually review inventories, calculate cubic footage and mileage, and determine guaranteed moving prices outside the website. We will enter the guaranteed price into Bubble and communicate it to the customer. Customers can accept their guaranteed price or enter the auction. Simplified Moving-Date Auctions We will operate one auction per moving date, with one winning customer per date. Customers click "Enter Auction" and submit a dollar bid through a simple website form. Each bid must be associated with the customer's account, moving date, and guaranteed price quote. Bid information will be recorded in Google Sheets for manual auction management. Customers compete only against others with the same moving date. We will manually calculate scores, manage rankings, close auctions, and select winners. Auction scoring formula: Score = (Customer Bid ÷ Customer Guaranteed Quote × 100) + Approved Social Media Tokens Customers are ranked by their scores, not simply by their dollar bids. Each approved social media post adds one token, equivalent to one additional score point. The website must display a simple leaderboard for each moving date showing anonymous bidder IDs, rankings, and scores. We will manage leaderboard data in Google Sheets. The website should display the leaderboard and reflect our spreadsheet updates. Customers can click "View Auction Rankings" to see their moving date's leaderboard. No automated scoring, live bidding engine, or automatic winner-selection system is required. We will manually announce the winner. The winning customer pays their winning dollar bid amount, not their guaranteed quote. They have 24 hours after the auction closes to submit payment. We will arrange moving-company fulfillment separately, outside the website. Referral and Social Media Tokens We will use Google Forms and Google Sheets to manage the referral program. Each auction participant receives a unique referral link or code to share with friends and family. Customers and their friends or family can submit links to qualifying social media posts through a Google Form. Friends and family do not need website accounts. Submissions are collected in Google Sheets. We manually review and approve social media posts. Each approved post earns one token, adding one point to the customer's auction score. We manually update token totals and auction rankings in our Google Sheets leaderboard. The website should provide customers with their referral link or code and straightforward access to the referral submission form. No custom referral-management system or automatic token approval is required. Bubble Database and Administration We want to use Bubble's existing database editor and administrative functionality rather than build a custom admin dashboard. Bubble must support: Customer accounts and login. Moving dates and pickup/delivery addresses. Furniture selections, quantities, uploaded photos, and inventory lists. Viewing and managing customer submissions. Manual entry and updating of guaranteed price quotes. Customer bids and auction information. Basic customer records and booking/payment statuses. Google Sheets will handle auction scoring, rankings, and referral tokens. Google Forms will collect social media post submissions. Stripe will handle payments. We will manually manage quotes, referral approvals, auctions, winners, payment verification, and booking confirmations. No custom administrative dashboard or reporting system is required. Any additional administrative functionality must be approved in advance. Payments and Bookings When a customer accepts their guaranteed quote, we manually send a Stripe payment link for the quoted amount. Auction winners receive a manually issued Stripe payment link for their winning bid amount, with payment due within 24 hours of auction closing. We manually email customers payment instructions and booking confirmations. We manually verify payments through Stripe and update booking/payment statuses in Bubble. Bubble only needs to store customer quotes, booking details, and payment/booking statuses. No custom Stripe integration, saved payment cards, automatic charging, or automated payment workflows are required. Customer-Facing Information Customers must be able to access the following information on the website: Their submitted moving details, inventory, and guaranteed price quote. Their submitted auction bid and moving date. Their moving-date auction leaderboard. Their booking status, such as pending or confirmed. Their referral link or code and access to the social media submission form. This information can appear on basic account pages, a simple dashboard, or other appropriate website pages. We do not require a dedicated custom dashboard. Please use whichever Bubble implementation is simplest and most cost-effective. Website Design and Technical Requirements Build the website using Bubble, within our own Bubble account. Responsive, professional design for desktop and mobile. Simple navigation and customer-friendly forms. Use Bubble's native functionality wherever practical. Google Forms and Google Sheets will support referrals and auction administration. No AI recognition, automated pricing engine, or Google Maps API integration is required. Avoid unnecessary custom code, plugins, and external services. Ownership, Accounts, Plugins, and Documentation Full ownership and independent maintainability are essential requirements. All development must take place within our Bubble account, which we create, own, and control. We will provide individually revocable developer access. We will not transfer ownership or share master login credentials. All third-party accounts, integrations, subscriptions, API credentials, and licenses must be registered under our ownership and control. Before using any external service or plugin, the freelancer must identify its purpose, provide the service link, explain any costs, and obtain our approval. Wherever possible, access must be granted through individual permissions rather than shared passwords. Any necessary custom code must be stored in our private GitHub repository. Any custom Bubble plugins must remain under our ownership and control, with their source code accessible and editable by future developers. The website must not depend on the original freelancer's personal accounts, private integrations, or inaccessible code. Provide basic documentation explaining the Bubble database structure, website functionality, integrations, plugins, and any custom code. All necessary access credentials, account ownership, and administrative permissions must remain under our control. Independent Technical Audit and Final Acceptance Before final acceptance and payment, an independent technical auditor will review the completed project to verify: Full ownership and access to the Bubble application and required external services. Accessibility and editability of any custom code or plugins. Proper functionality of the agreed website features and integrations. Documentation and future maintainability. The freelancer must correct any issues identified during the audit before final acceptance and payment. Freelancer Proposal Requirements Please provide: Your experience building websites with Bubble and examples of relevant completed projects. Your total fixed-price bid for the complete scope described above. Your estimated completion timeline. Any necessary Bubble plan, plugins, third-party services, subscriptions, or other ongoing costs. Confirmation that all development, accounts, code, and plugins will remain under our ownership and control. Confirmation that you agree to the independent audit and correction requirements. Any questions or additional information you need before beginning. Our priority is a fully functional, professional, affordable first version of Free Moving Marketplace using Bubble's existing capabilities, simple forms, Google Sheets, and manual administration wherever practical.

item.title: Magazine Production & Digital Operations VA
item.description:
5-10 GBP/hr | # Magazine Production & Digital Operations VA | WordPress, Facebook & AI
**Remote | 10–15 hours per week initially | Potential 40 hours per week from January 2027**
### About the Opportunity
We're launching **Around Ashford**, a brand-new UK local publishing and digital media business, on **1st December 2026**.
Our business includes six bi-monthly local magazines, an online business directory, community events, local advertising and plans for national franchise expansion.
Our website is almost ready, and we're looking for an exceptional VA to join us before launch, learn our systems and help us grow.
**This is a long-term opportunity, not a collection of occasional freelance tasks.**
### Your Responsibilities
**Magazine Production** - Produce professional magazine layouts ready for commercial printing. - Prepare print-ready PDFs, including CMYK, bleed, crop marks and correct resolution. - Manage advertising artwork, production deadlines and printer communication. - Coordinate production across six magazine editions.
**Facebook Marketing** - Create compelling, scroll-stopping Facebook posts. - Design graphics using Canva and AI. - Schedule regular posts to build awareness before and after launch. - Promote businesses, events and advertising opportunities. - Help grow our audience and generate enquiries.
**Email Marketing** - Write engaging, persuasive emails. - Schedule campaigns using Brevo. - Manage contact tagging, segmentation and email lists. - Create automated follow-up sequences and newsletters. - Track enquiries and responses.
**WordPress & Business Operations** - Learn and manage our new WordPress backend. - Maintain directory listings, events, jobs and advertiser accounts. - Manage customer enquiries, bookings and renewals. - Coordinate day-to-day administration and suppliers. - Find opportunities to improve efficiency using AI and automation.
### Communication Is Extremely Important
You MUST speak excellent, fluent English and be confident speaking with UK customers and suppliers by telephone or Zoom.
You must also have:
- Professional-quality headset and microphone. - Excellent audio quality without background noise. - Fast, reliable and secure internet. - Backup internet and power arrangements. - Secure computer and quiet working environment. - Availability during agreed UK working hours.
### The Person We're Looking For
Our founder is a fast-moving entrepreneur who values speed, initiative and results.
**We want facts, not lengthy explanations.**
When asked a question, give a clear, concise answer. We don't need a chapter explaining how you intend to complete a task.
You should be:
- Highly proactive and self-motivated. - Extremely organised and dependable. - Quick to learn new systems. - Confident making sensible decisions independently. - Comfortable using ChatGPT and AI daily. - Commercially aware and interested in business growth. - Able to work quickly without sacrificing quality.
**Previous experience producing magazines for commercial printers is essential.**
### Hours & Growth
**November 2026:** 10–15 hours weekly, learning our systems and preparing for launch.
**1st December 2026:** Official launch.
**January 2027 onwards:** Potential to increase towards 40 hours weekly as the business gains momentum.
Facebook marketing will be central to generating awareness and attracting customers.
The faster we grow our audience, acquire advertisers and generate revenue, the sooner we expect to increase working hours.
We want someone who is motivated to help make that happen!
### How to Apply
Please include:
1. Examples of magazines you have personally produced for commercial printing. 2. A 60–90 second video introducing yourself in English. 3. Your experience with WordPress, Facebook, Canva, Brevo and ChatGPT. 4. Details of your headset, internet connection and backup arrangements. 5. Your hourly rate and availability for UK working hours.
**Applications without evidence of magazine production experience will not be considered.**
We're looking for one outstanding person who wants to grow with our business and become a trusted, long-term member of our team.
